join: unique normalized port name plus country matches;39 island-port candidates reviewed by name and country; no claim of independent spatial identity validation
predictor: mean PLSCI2006-2010 with>=16 of20 quarters available
cohorts: all completed flora ports satisfying join/time rule; nested single-island port subset; islands aggregated over that subset
outcomes: distinct recorded alien candidate host richness; alien/(native+alien) host richness where denominator>0
island_aggregation: maximum port connectivity and distinct plant union across eligible ports, requiring unanimous regional classification per host
comparison: Spearman descriptive correlation; no ordinary independent-sample p-value or causal claim; no radius acquisition or matched controls
limits: Plant inventory pooled2001-2024, connectivity2006-2010 is not a prospective predictor of plant introductions; observation effort and biogeography remain. Port index is neither cargo volume nor actual island-pair links.
